title: US chip equipment giant Applied Materials to grow S’pore workforce past 5,000 and boost investment
html:
Applied Materials chief executive officer Gary Dickerson said his company’s commitment is driven by what he described as “incredible talent, incredible culture and a great partnership with the Government”.

ST PHOTO: ARIFFIN JAMAR

Ovais Subhani

AI generated

SINGAPORE – After adding more than 2,000 workers in Singapore in roughly two years, US semiconductor equipment giant Applied Materials is gearing up for its next phase of expansion in the Republic.

Beyond boosting its local headcount, the company – which makes machines and tools used to produce semiconductor chips – has already doubled its production capacity and research and development (R&D) footprint here.
summary: It has doubled its production capacity and R&D footprint in the Republic.
